quotes.text: Neil was great! I’d definitely recommend fishing with him.

Captain Neil and First Mate Tara were top notch, first class. The scenery was beautiful and we caught a couple of fish. Captain Neil and Tara both taught us different fishing methods. Most importantly, we had a lot of fun. We look forward to going out fishing with them again sometime.
